第6版は線形・等方・受動・非磁性板、真空中の一次元垂直入射、単一Lorentz共鳴または導電損失。旧TMz/TEz例も保持。 境界条件: 第6版は遠方PEC外端、PMLなし、半体積平均の整合界面と真空モニター。旧周期/PEC・PML例を保持。 単位系: 無次元。長さ・時間・場を規格化。 Yee FDTDの専用配布版と固定入力 教育用Yee FDTD。真空・Fresnel界面・s/p偏光・PMLの既存例を保持し、第6版で一次元垂直入射のOhmic・受動Lorentz板を追加。帯域解析解、反射・透過・直接散逸・物質蓄積、修正離散収支・物理流束と格子・時間収束を分けて検査。一般分散、多共鳴、斜め分散入射、分散PML、一般2/3次元の包括的検証ではない。 取得・実行手順 / README · コード・固定入力・結果 ZIP · Other names: FDTD法 / finite difference time domain / 有限差分時間領域法 / Yee法 Read the formulation Read the chapter Assumptions for this example New r6: linear isotropic passive nonmagnetic finite slabs in vacuum, 1D normal incidence, one Lorentz resonance or Ohmic conduction. Earlier TMz/TEz cases retained. Boundaries: New r6: distant PEC caps, no PML, aligned half-volume slab interfaces and vacuum monitors. Earlier periodic/PEC and PML examples retained. Units: Dimensionless normalized length, time and fields. Dedicated Yee FDTD edition and fixed inputs Educational Yee FDTD: retained vacuum/Fresnel/s-p/PML examples plus r6 1D normal-incidence Ohmic and passive Lorentz slabs. Spectral references, R/T, direct dissipation, material storage, modified/physical budgets and space/time refinement are separate checks. Not blanket validation of general dispersion, multiple resonances, oblique dispersive incidence, dispersive PML or general 2D/3D. 取得・実行手順 / README · Code, fixed inputs and results ZIP · File manifest / SHA-256 · 108 tests passed / independent-extraction verification solver.py run.py scattering.py run_scattering.py corner.py run_corner.py oblique.py run_oblique.py polarization.py run_polarization.py dispersive.py run_dispersive.py test_fdtd.py test_scattering.py test_corner.py test_oblique.py test_polarization.py test_dispersive.py Periodic plane wave / JSON PEC cavity / JSON Dielectric reflection and transmission / JSON PML reflection and energy balance / JSON Four-side and corner PML reflection and energy balance / JSON Oblique dielectric-interface incidence / Fresnel comparison / JSON p polarization, Brewster angle and total internal reflection / JSON Reflection, transmission and absorption by lossy/dispersive slabs / JSON python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q test_fdtd.py test_scattering.py test_corner.py test_oblique.py test_polarization.py test_dispersive.py python run.py --input inputs/periodic-wave.json --output rerun-periodic-wave python run.py --input inputs/pec-cavity.json --output rerun-pec-cavity python run_scattering.py --input inputs/dielectric-interface.json --output rerun-dielectric-interface python run_scattering.py --input inputs/pml-pulse.json --output rerun-pml-pulse python run_corner.py --input inputs/pml-corners.json --output rerun-pml-corners python run_oblique.py --input inputs/dielectric-oblique.json --output rerun-dielectric-oblique python run_polarization.py --input inputs/p-polarization.json --output rerun-p-polarization python run_dispersive.py --input inputs/loss-dispersion.json --output rerun-loss-dispersion MIT License · Terms for prose, figures and data Scope and remaining work Educational Yee FDTD: retained vacuum/Fresnel/s-p/PML examples plus r6 1D normal-incidence Ohmic and passive Lorentz slabs.
